what: Sections of different colors stick (sticky) one after another and the next section rises from below to cover it. Each section has only its top-right corner rounded large (clamp 2.5~7rem), and that rounded notch is filled with the previous section’s background color so it looks like a sheet laid over the previous one. While the next section rises from the screen bottom to the top, the previous section’s black veil deepens 0→.3 (scrub, linear) and the notch darkens with it. A section taller than the screen is read to the end before it sticks

options.shade: Dimming value at the end of the front layer, default .3 — 0 means stacking only
options.start · end: Darkening range (relative to the next section), default ”top bottom” · ”top top”
options.look: If flat-first, the first sheet has no corners (when the original first sheet has a white background)
options.[data-fx-part=chapter]: Stacking section (direct child) — each section paints its own background color
